assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered.
The study is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods.
The service addresses the diagnosed condition of atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The service addresses the diagnosed condition of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5).
The conditions are reflected in the member's benefit plan determination under denial code PR-204.
